name: SCALEDIF
description: SCALEDIF is a benchmark designed to evaluate instruction following in large language models with a scaled instruction volume of up to ten instructions per data sample. It measures how well models follow multiple instructions and analyzes the impact of instruction conflict on performance.
reputation: A recent benchmark for multi-instruction following that is mainly used in research on instruction adherence rather than broad community leaderboards.
notes: Includes a quantitative conflict scoring tool to explain performance trends and provide feedback on instruction tension.
